name: hud_branch_card
description: The command card is positional (design 5.7): Q W E place the Builder's three towers and A S D are Signal, Sell and Ready, each slot showing its key. On my own unforked tower Q and W show its two branches with the hammer, the fork's cost and the glyph of the check a branch lifts, and E empties; W buys branch B. On the forked tower the branch taken stays lit, the other greys, and a fork key says a fork is final. A Lookout plays her own kit on the same keys.

steps.assert: [card[0].key, card[1].key, card[2].key, card[3].key, card[4].key, card[5].key] == ['Q', 'W', 'E', 'A', 'S', 'D'] and card[0].key_shown and card[5].key_shown
steps.msg: every slot shows its key: Q W E over A S D

steps.assert: [card[0].what, card[1].what, card[2].what, card[3].what, card[4].what, card[5].what] == ['perch_ballista', 'hawk_roost', 'owls_eye', 'signal', 'sell', 'ready'] and card[0].icon == 'res://ui/icons/perch_ballista.png' and card[2].icon == 'res://ui/icons/owls_eye.png'
steps.msg: Q W E hold the Lookout's three towers with their icons; A signals, S sells, D is Ready

steps.assert: card[0].cost == '75' and not card[0].hammer and card[0].glyph == ''
steps.msg: a tower to place shows its price, no hammer
Q takes up her first tower, its slot lit

steps.assert: card[0].what == 'siege_perch' and card[1].what == 'pinning_ballista' and card[0].hammer and card[1].hammer and card[0].icon == 'res://ui/icons/siege_perch.png' and card[1].icon == 'res://ui/icons/pinning_ballista.png'
steps.msg: on her own unforked tower Q and W show its two branches, each with the hammer

steps.assert: card[0].cost == '90' and card[1].cost == '90' and card[0].state == 'ok' and card[1].state == 'ok'

steps.msg: the branch that patches a weak check carries its glyph (the Pinning Ballista lifts Swift)

steps.assert: card[2].what == '' and not card[2].key_shown and card[2].icon == '' and card[2].state == 'idle'
steps.msg: E empties: there is no third branch
S sells it for 70% of the 75 paid, rounded half up

steps.assert: node('Tooltip').visible and screen_has('Pinning Ballista') and screen_has('(W)') and screen_has('Damage 32.0 to 36.0 · slow 0% to 50%') and node('TooltipHelps').visible and screen_has('Lifts Swift to passable')
steps.msg: the branch's tooltip: its name and key, what changes in numbers, and the check it lifts

steps.assert: node('Title').text == 'Pinning Ballista' and node('Title').size.x > 100 and node('TitleGlyph').visible and node('TitleGlyph').get_meta('check') == 'swift' and node('TitleGlyph').get_global_rect().position.x >= node('Title').get_global_rect().end.x
steps.msg: the selection is named for its branch, the glyph of the check it lifts beside the name
its numbers show the slow it adds and the armour it pierces

steps.assert: card[1].state == 'lit' and card[1].active and card[1].cost == '' and card[0].state == 'idle' and not card[0].active and not card[0].hammer
steps.msg: the forked tower: the branch taken stays lit, the other greys

steps.assert: node('Notice').visible and node('Notice').text == 'A fork is final' and scene.settled() and scene.tower_at(Vector2i(8, 3)).form == 'pinning_ballista'
steps.msg: a fork key on it orders nothing: a fork is final
with nothing selected the card holds her towers again
